item.title: feat(feishu): let agents resend received stickers (#130374)
item.summary: feat(feishu): let agents resend received stickers (#130374) * feat(feishu): resend received stickers without losing topic routing Add opt-in agent sticker sending using received file keys, preserve inbound keys, and stop unsupported sticker resource downloads. Reuse keyed-media delivery and canonical reply selection; inherit source topics only within the same destination and account. Related: #114578. * fix(feishu): preserve topic mode for prepared implicit replies * docs(feishu): preserve account action gates when enabling stickers
